name: Sienna Grande Shops
summary: Sienna Grande Shops is a community shopping center serving Missouri City's rapidly growing Sienna Plantation master-planned community. Managed by Regency Centers, the property offers a convenient mix of restaurants, salons, medical offices, and fitness facilities tailored to neighborhood residents.
demographics: Sienna Grande Shops serves the rapidly growing Sienna Plantation master-planned community in Missouri City, which attracts primarily upper-middle-class families with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000. The trade area consists predominantly of young to middle-aged professionals (ages 30-55) with children, drawn to the area's highly-rated schools and suburban lifestyle. The shopping center caters to convenience-oriented shoppers seeking everyday services including dining, personal care, fitness, and medical facilities within their residential community.
description: Sienna Grande Shops is a community shopping center strategically located in Missouri City's Sienna Plantation, recognized as the fourth-fastest-growing master-planned community in the Houston metropolitan area. Developed and managed by Regency Centers, this property serves the thriving residential population along Sienna Parkway with a carefully curated mix of neighborhood-serving retailers and service providers. The center features a diverse tenant lineup including restaurants, salons, medical offices, and fitness facilities, all designed to meet the daily needs of the surrounding community. As part of Regency Centers' portfolio of thriving neighborhood centers, Sienna Grande Shops benefits from professional management and a commitment to creating vibrant gathering places that enhance the local community. The center's location within one of Houston's most desirable master-planned communities positions it as a convenient destination for residents seeking quality shopping, dining, and services close to home.
